messages:
oncall-bot: Pager: high-severity alert for tenant:jupiter-bank-prod - verbose request logging enabled after failover, PII appearing in logs. Paging on-call.
olivia (on-call): Got the page, looking. Noted this is the dedicated pool `jupiter-pool-2` behind VPC. Impact: some request bodies with SSNs/Acct numbers in plain text are surfacing in the application logs. :grimacing:
samir (sre): Confirmed. Logs show repeated full-request dumps from image `redwood-runtime:v3.2.1` after failover at 01:18 UTC. Example snippet (sanitized):
```
{"request":{"user_id":"U-12345","ssn":"123-45-6789","prompt":"..."}}
```
samir (sre): Root cause appears to be a mis-flagged feature toggle that enabled `DEBUG_PAYLOAD_LOGGING=true` during yesterday's quick rollback. We need to strip existing logs and stop further writes to long-term retention.
olivia (on-call): First mitigation: disable verbose logging on the pool, and switch serving side to redact request payloads in-memory. I'll run the quick toggle and create a ticket for a safer rollout.
josh (infra): Pushing toggle now to the pool. Command I'm using:
```
kubectl -n jupiter set env deploy/model-runtime DEBUG_PAYLOAD_LOGGING=false --selector=pool=jupiter-pool-2
```
josh (infra): Also temporarily mounted ephemeral logging (no persistence) for those pods. Deploy bot, can you confirm rollout?
deploy-bot: Rolling update started for selector pool=jupiter-pool-2. 6/6 pods updated. Monitors: ok -> 200s.
olivia (on-call): Toggle applied. Verified no new plaintext payload lines in live tail. We still need to handle records already persisted to our log store (s3://redwood-logs/jupiter-bank/...).
natalie (customer-success): Pinged the customer (Jupiter Bank) and told them we're containing it and doing an internal review. They requested confirmation about retention/erasure timeline and legal steps.
tia (legal): We need a redaction/retention exception request logged and reviewed. Because Jupiter Bank has a legal hold on transaction set TX-984, we must not delete evidence without legal approval. However we can quarantine and restrict access. Please file a formal exception request with the following fields: tenant, affected paths, justification, requested action (quarantine vs deletion), retention hold id.
olivia (on-call): Filed exception request: `redaction-exception:jupiter-1832459012`. Details:
- tenant: tenant:jupiter-bank-prod
- paths: s3://redwood-logs/jupiter-bank/prod/**/2026-03-12-01*
- justification: PII exposure via debug logging after failover; customer notified; legal hold present for TX-984.
- requested action: quarantine + redaction pipeline + limited access for Legal & CS for 72h pending review
- requested by: olivia (on-call)
samir (sre): Technical plan for redaction: run redact-pass to mask SSNs and account numbers, write redacted copies to quarantined prefix, and rotate KMS keys used for access. Pipeline snippet:
```
redact-pass --input s3://redwood-logs/jupiter-bank/... --pattern ssn,acctnum --output s3://quarantine/jupiter-bank/redacted/ --kms-key alias/redwood-quarantine
```
samir (sre): Note: Do NOT run a blanket delete due to legal hold. Quarantine + redaction preserves chain-of-custody.
tia (legal): Agreed. I'll coordinate with Jupiter Bank legal to confirm if they want deletion after their review. For now, approve quarantine+redaction and restricted access. Legal requires audit log entries for who touched the quarantined objects.
natalie (customer-success): I'll set up a joint bridge with customer legal in 30m and provide timeline. Also giving them the incident summary and mitigation steps.
olivia (on-call): Assigning action items:
- samir: run redaction pass to quarantined location and produce digest (sha256) of original vs redacted objects (do not store original paths in open channels). ETA 2h.
- josh: enforce IAM changes so only `legal@redwood` and `cs-jupiter` can access the quarantine prefix. ETA 30m.
- tia: coordinate legal approval and document exception id. ETA 2-6h depending on customer.
- natalie: customer comms and bridge. ETA 30m.
- olivia: follow up and handoff to night on-call at 22:00 PST if not resolved.
samir (sre): Starting redaction pass now. Will post progress updates. Using ephemeral worker to avoid touching production endpoints. Running in dry-run first.
samir (sre): dry-run shows ~1.2k objects affected, ~4GB total. Dry-run output (summary):
```
objects_found: 1203
estimated_time: 1h45m
sensitive_patterns: ssn, account_number, email
```
olivia (on-call): Good. Keep the team posted. Documenting incident in tracker INC-2026-183245 (internal).
josh (infra): IAM changes applied. Only legal & cs-jupiter roles have s3:GetObject on quarantine prefix now. Logging of access goes to audit s3://redwood-audit/.
tia (legal): Please ensure the exception request includes the cust legal contact and whether this is a preservation or deletion request. Also include the ticket INC-2026-183245 and the exception id.
natalie (customer-success): Added cust contacts: legal@jupiterbank.com, lead counsel: erin.lambert@jupiterbank.com. Bridge created: https://meet.example/xyz. Sharing now.
samir (sre): Redaction pass complete: 1203 objects processed, redacted copies in s3://quarantine/jupiter-bank/redacted/ . Checksums generated. No originals deleted. 
samir (sre): Uploading audit digest to ticket INC-2026-183245 (attachment: redaction-digest-1832459012.txt).
olivia (on-call): Thanks. Handoff: if legal approves deletion after review, we'll follow legal flow for deletion with recorded approvals. If not, keep quarantined and maintain limited access. Night on-call is @olivia, will take over at 22:00 PST.
deploy-bot: Notification: config update `logging.v2.redact=true` rolled to jupiter-pool-2 via deploy 2026-03-12-udpate-logs.
olivia (on-call): Closing immediate page. Root cause: toggle left enabled during rollback. Follow-ups: run postmortem, add an alert for debug-toggle flips in dedicated pools, and add pre-commit check to avoid enabling full-request dumps in production. cc @product @eng-sre for followup.
tia (legal): Exception documented and approved for quarantine+redaction pending cust confirmation. Exception id: RE-2026-JUP-42. Saved to legal case system.
natalie (customer-success): Customer acknowledged and will respond re: deletion by EOD. Bridge ended. :white_check_mark:
olivia (on-call): Marking thread as contained. Will update INC and postmortem notes later. If anything changes, ping this thread or page on-call. Thanks team. :bow:
